title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 47: Headings for the Sidebar

scores.question:
Substack's sidebar cuts 46 of your 62 headings. I gave Fable the headings brief the inner child lane made from your picks there (every heading fits its room, says what the reader came for, keeps your words and your playful ones where it can). It kept 11 as they are and shortened 51, all of them fitting. Then fresh readers, who saw only a contents as the sidebar shows it, said where they would look first in 32 situations a reader brings (written from the text with the headings taken out, and checked by a second reader).

Your evidence tags go under the headings, not in them: in a heading, "[Tried by Me and Friends]" alone takes more than an h3's room, so the remedy's name would be cut. Each remedy below shows its tag.

Each heading starts on my pick: Fable's, with three headings back in your words where its readers went wrong ("MDMA: Magnesium Alarm", "Trip After Trip?", "Feeling Good Forever?"). Change any you like, or use a button; your answers save as you click. When you're done, tell me in the chat (or press "Copy my answers" and paste them).
